title: Orb and tall glowing figure filmed at a healing for a cancer patient

tellings.quote: All of a sudden in the video, you'll see an orb appear. It comes zooming right up to me

plain: During a healing session for a cancer patient at his home in North Carolina, around 2013 to 2015, a glowing ball of light and a tall glowing figure are said to have been caught on video. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and whom NASA scientists have studied, tells Michels he was there and that the footage shows it: "all of a sudden in the video, you'll see an orb appear. It comes zooming right up to me." He offers it as evidence that the lights he sees are tied to healing.
